창세기 5:1.content: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;

창세기 5:2.content: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

창세기 5:3.content: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat a son in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:

창세기 5:4.content: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:5.content: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.

창세기 5:6.content: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:

창세기 5:7.content: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:8.content: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.

창세기 5:9.content: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:

창세기 5:10.content: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:11.content: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.

창세기 5:12.content: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:

창세기 5:13.content: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:14.content: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.

창세기 5:15.content: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:

창세기 5:16.content: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:17.content: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.

창세기 5:18.content: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:

창세기 5:19.content: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:20.content: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.

창세기 5:21.content: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:

창세기 5:22.content: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:23.content: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:

창세기 5:24.content: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.

창세기 5:25.content: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:

창세기 5:26.content: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:27.content: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.

창세기 5:28.content: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:

창세기 5:29.content: And he called his name Noah, saying, This same shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the Lord hath cursed.

창세기 5:30.content: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:

창세기 5:31.content: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.

창세기 5:32.content: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
